text:
Evan: Seeing TLS client cert rejects from eu-nodes starting ~11:20 UTC. Handshake logs show KMS Decrypt AccessDenied.
Maya: Alerting showed a KMS deny burst at 11:21. No other obvious infra changes.
Ibrahim: I pushed a key-policy tweak last night adding an aws:SourceVpc condition to limit decrypts to our managed VPCs. I thought proxy egress would be inside that VPC.
Jules: Our EU proxies egress via a shared NAT managed by infra; the NAT moved to a new subnet last week. SourceVpc could be different.
Evan: Snippet from proxy: `2026-05-02T11:21:05Z proxy-eu unwrap error: KMS:AccessDeniedException Decrypt denied for arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/proxy-keystore`
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1599 created and assigned to eng-security.
Maya: Short fixes: 1) revert policy change, 2) add new NAT subnet to policy, 3) switch guards to EncryptionContext keys. Revert seems fastest.
Ibrahim: Rolling back now (revert-id r-2026-559). Will post status.
Jules: Can we add a tiny in-memory keystore cache for 2 minutes as a safety valve? Operator-gated only.
Maya: We previously disabled cache-on-deny to avoid silent key reuse. If we enable it, keep it very short and emit an event when used.
Ibrahim: Revert applied at 11:24 UTC. Decrypt successes rising.
Evan: Handshakes recovering in eu; monitoring 30m.
Maya: Followups: (a) policy preflight in IAM pipeline that simulates denies against known assumed-role ARNs and egress VPCs, (b) add EncryptionContext tags (service, request_id) to decrypt calls so CloudTrail ties denies to requests, (c) add metric iam.kms.policy.rollout{change_id} emitted on deploy.
Jules: I'll open INFRA tickets for the cache operator flag and the preflight emulator. Ibrahim please add CI lint to flag aws:SourceIp/SourceVpc use in key policies without an allowlist.
Ibrahim: Will add checks and a short smoke test that does a decrypt from each region post-policy deploy.
Maya: Runbook update: add CloudWatch Logs Insights query to find denies quickly:
```
fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, errorMessage
| filter eventName = "Decrypt" and errorMessage like /AccessDenied/
| stats count() by userIdentity.arn, bin(1m)
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
```
Evan: Closing for now, schedule postmortem tomorrow. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
